fact: 1913年12月23日，美国总统伍德罗·威尔逊签署《联邦储备法》（Federal Reserve Act，Pub. L. 63-43，38 Stat. 251），联邦储备体系由此成立。该体系由一个位于华盛顿的联邦储备委员会与12家区域性联邦储备银行组成。

sources.title: Federal Reserve Board, Federal Reserve History（官方沿革页）
sources.quote: The Federal Reserve System was created on December 23, 1913, when President Woodrow Wilson signed the Federal Reserve Act into law. The system is composed of a central, independent governmental agency--the Board of Governors--in Washington, D.C., and 12 regional Federal Reserve Banks, located in major cities throughout the nation.

sources.title: Library of Congress, Research Guides: Federal Reserve Act Signed
sources.quote: the law was passed by Congress and President Wilson signed it on December 23, 1913.

fact: 《联邦储备法》的前身H.R. 7837号法案（俗称「货币法案」或格拉斯-欧文法案）由众议员卡特·格拉斯于1913年8月29日提出；众议院于9月18日通过，参议院于12月18日通过，两院联席会议12月22日达成一致，众议院当日以298对60票通过，参议院12月23日以43对25票通过。各来源对参议院首次表决日期有12月18日与12月19日两种写法。

sources.title: Library of Congress, Research Guides: Federal Reserve Act Signed
sources.quote: it did serve as a basis for another bill - H.R. 7837 sometimes called the currency bill or Glass-Owens, that Carter Glass introduced on August 29, 1913

sources.title: 凤凰网,i.ifeng,《恐慌与妥协：美联储的诞生》
sources.quote: 终于在12月19日，参议院以54票对34票通过欧文法案。23日下午六点，威尔逊走进椭圆形办公室。

sources.title: Federal Reserve Act（维基百科镜像页，含立法历程表决记录）
sources.quote: Passed the House on September 18, 1913 (287–85, 5 Present) Passed the Senate on December 18, 1913 (54–34) Reported by the joint conference committee on December 22, 1913; agreed to by the House on December 22, 1913 (298–60) and by the Senate on December 23, 1913 (43–25)

fact: 《联邦储备法》的方案谱系可追至1910年11月：参议员纳尔逊·奥尔德里奇与保罗·沃伯格、弗兰克·范德利普、亨利·戴维森、A. 皮亚特·安德鲁等人在佐治亚州杰基尔岛闭门起草，与会者互称名字以保密，后自称「名字俱乐部」；该方案以「奥尔德里奇计划」提交国会未获通过，其中若干条款被1913年的格拉斯-欧文法案吸收。本杰明·斯特朗是否到会，各家记述不一致。

sources.title: Federal Reserve History, The Meeting at Jekyll Island（Gary Richardson）
sources.quote: Once aboard, the men used only first names—Nelson, Harry, Frank, Paul, Piatt, and Arthur—to prevent the staff from learning their identities. For decades after, the group referred to themselves as the "First Name Club." ... But it is unlikely Strong attended the meeting on Jekyll Island. In his autobiography, Vanderlip recalls him attending, but no other account indicates Strong's presence.

sources.quote: So secretive was the meeting that even the exact list of participants is lost to history. In his autobiography, Vanderlip says Benjamin Strong attended ... But Strong is absent from other historical accounts

fact: 《联邦储备法》签署后，储备银行的组织与开业排到1914年：1914年4月2日，储备银行组织委员会公布12家储备银行所在城市；1914年8月13日联邦储备委员会首次开会；1914年11月储备体系开始运作。即1913年内只完成立法，尚无任何一家联邦储备银行营业。

sources.title: Library of Congress, Research Guides: Federal Reserve Act Signed
sources.quote: on April 2, 1914, the Reserve Bank Organization Committee announced its decision for the location of the twelve Federal Reserve district banks. By November 1914 the Fed was operational. ... The first meeting of the Federal Reserve was August 13, 1914.

sources.title: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Beginnings（FRASER 影印）
sources.quote: Under an organizing committee headed by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with representatives of banks, clearing houses, major industries and business associations, delineation of the resulting twelve Federal Reserve Districts occasioned considerable dispute in some sections of the country.

fact: 《联邦储备法》第2条规定：由财政部长、农业部长与货币监理官组成「储备银行组织委员会」，在不少于8个、不多于12个城市设立联邦储备城市，并把美国本土（不含阿拉斯加）划为对应数量的区；划区须「适当顾及便利与惯常商业路线」，且「不必与任何州的边界一致」。该委员会的决定除联邦储备委员会外不受复审。

sources.title: Wikisource, Federal Reserve Act（1913年原文，Pub.L. 63-43）
sources.quote: As soon as practicable, the Secretary of the Treasury, the Secretary of Agriculture and the Comptroller of the Currency, acting as “The Reserve Bank Organization Committee,” shall designate not less than eight nor more than twelve cities to bo known as Federal reserve cities ... Provided, That the districts shall be apportioned with due regard to the convenience and customary course of business and shall not necessarily be coterminous with any State or States.

fact: 《联邦储备法》第2条要求：每一家国民银行必须在法案通过后60天内书面接受法案条款；在组织委员会划定辖区后30天内，按其「实收资本与公积金」的6%认购所在储备银行的股本，其中六分之一经组织委员会或联邦储备委员会催缴即付、六分之一在3个月内、六分之一在6个月内缴付，余款随时可催，且须以金币或金券支付。

sources.title: Wikisource, Federal Reserve Act（1913年原文，Sec. 2）
sources.quote: every national banking association within that district shall be required within thirty days after notice from the organization committee, to subscribe to the capital stock of such Federal reserve bank in a sum equal to six per centum of the paid-up capital stock and surplus of such bank, one-sixth of the subscription to be payable on call of the organization committee or of the Federal Reserve Board, one-sixth within three months and one-sixth within six months thereafter ... said payments to be in gold or gold certificates.

fact: 美国宪法第十六修正案于1913年2月3日获得足够州批准而生效（国务卿诺克斯于2月25日认证）；同年10月3日威尔逊签署《1913年收入法》（安德伍德关税法），对超过3000美元的净收入征1%的常规税（已婚者另加1000美元免征额），2万至5万美元以上部分加征1%至6%的累进附加税，公司净收入统一按1%征税。

On February 25, 1913, Secretary of State Philander Knox certified that the amendment had become part of the U.S. Constitution as the Sixteenth Amendment. ... signed into law by President Woodrow Wilson on October 3, 1913, creating our modern income tax system.

fact: 依《联邦储备法》，会员银行认购的储备银行股本不得在市场上转让，只能取得法定6%的年股息；国民银行强制入会，州银行自愿入会。储备银行股本因此不是可在交易所买卖的证券，1913年并不存在「美联储股票」的二级市场。

sources.quote: membership was made compulsory for national banks but voluntary for state banks, while stock holdings, which cannot be traded in the market, were (and still are) limited to a statutory dividend of 6 percent.

sources.quote: every national banking association in the United States is hereby required, and every eligible bank in the United States and every trust company within the District of Columbia, is hereby authorized to signify in writing, within sixty days after the passage of this Act, its acceptance of the terms and provisions hereof.

fact: 《联邦储备法》的立法目标写明为「提供弹性通货、办理商业票据再贴现、对银行业实行更有效的监督」，并创设一种新的统一通货「联邦储备券」（Federal Reserve Note）。法案通过时距1907年恐慌六年，其间美国通货供应被普遍认为「无弹性」。

fact: 美国劳工统计局《零售价格，1890年至1913年12月》记载：以1890—1899年均价为100，按工人家庭消费量加权计算的15种主要食品零售价指数在1913年为163.4，为该报告覆盖24年中的最高值；1913年11月为加权指数的历史峰值。该15种食品约占工人家庭食品支出的三分之二，价格采自40个工业城市（覆盖全美本土五分之一人口）。

fact: 1913年福特汽车公司工人的基本工资为每天2.34美元、每班9小时；底特律当时已属高工资城市。1914年1月5日公司宣布把最低日薪提到5美元并把工时降到8小时，该政策自宣布后生效，属1914年而非1913年的事实。

sources.title: National Park Service, National Register of Historic Places Inventory—Nomination Form（Highland Park Ford Plant, NHLS 78001516）
sources.quote: His announcement of the "Five Dollar Day" on January 5, 1914, made him a worldwide figure ... when he pointed out that workers should be paid high wages so that they might buy the goods they produced.

sources.title: 人民网,《向「汽车界的哥白尼」致敬》（2013-08-09）
sources.quote: 为了降低工人的流动率，1914年1月5日起，福特率先实行8小时工作制。他废除了之前工作9小时、2.34美元工资的制度，将时间减少到8小时，并将工资提高到5美元。

fact: 1913年福特T型车厂价：Touring（五座）600美元，Runabout（两座）525美元，Town Car 800美元，Delivery Car 625美元，底盘960美元。同年福特总产量170,211辆（Touring 126,715、Runabout 33,129、Town Car 1,415、Delivery 513、底盘8,438等），较1912年的68,773辆增长约1.5倍。

sources.quote: This 1913 runabout sold new for $525 in 1913 and was one of 33,129 runabout models built that year. ... Sales of the Model T continued to climb and nearly 200,000 Model T Fords were built and sold in 1913.

fact: 1913年4月1日前后，底特律高地公园工厂把飞轮磁电机装到移动线上：29名工人各做一道工序，单台装配时间由约20分钟降至13分钟，进一步调整后降至5分钟。这是福特第一条大规模应用的移动装配线，先于整车总装。

sources.title: The Henry Ford, Ford Methods and the Ford Shops（Matt Anderson）
sources.quote: Around April 1, 1913, flywheel magnetos were placed on moving lines. Instead of one worker completing one flywheel in some 20 minutes, a group of workers stood along a waist-high platform ... One whole flywheel came off the line every 13 minutes. With further tweaking, the assembly line produced a finished flywheel magneto in just five minutes.

sources.title: Assembly Magazine, Assembly Then & Now: The Man Behind the Moving Assembly Line
sources.quote: On April 1, 1913, the first moving assembly line for a large-scale manufacturing application began to operate. It was used to produce flywheel magnetos.

fact: 整车底盘上线的时点各家口径不一：一说1913年8月首次试行，把底盘工时从12.5小时降到约6小时，10月已降到约3小时；一说1913年10月7日移动底盘装配开始；一说1913年12月1日连续移动总装线投入运行，把整车装配时间从728分钟降到93分钟。三种说法可并存于分阶段推广过程中。

sources.title: National Park Service, NRHP Nomination（Highland Park Ford Plant）
sources.quote: By December 1, a continuously moving final assembly line went into operation which reduced assembly time of a completed automobile from 728 minutes to 93 minutes.

sources.title: Classic Cars Arena, Henry Ford's Assembly Line（汇列各家日期）
sources.quote: October 7, 1913, is the day most published sources give as the start of moving chassis assembly at Highland Park. The museum's curator puts the first trial in August. One later history gives December 1, 1913, as full implementation. All three can be true. The rollout was staged

fact: 1913年内福特把移动线逐级推广到分总成：6月用于变速箱，装配时间由18分钟降到9分钟；11月用于发动机，由594分钟降到226分钟。各级分总成线向总装线供料，使整厂节拍逐段压缩。

sources.title: Classic Cars Arena, Henry Ford's Assembly Line（引福特生产部门记录）
sources.quote: In June 1913 the line method was extended to transmissions, cutting assembly time from 18 minutes to 9. By November 1913 engines were on a line as well, and engine assembly fell from 594 minutes to 226.

sources.title: The Henry Ford, Ford Methods and the Ford Shops
sources.quote: Ford soon adapted the assembly line to engines, and then transmissions, and, in August 1913, to complete chassis.

fact: 移动装配线推广后福特T型车产量连年跳升：1913年170,211辆，1914年202,667辆，1917年735,020辆，1923年达2,011,125辆的峰值；T型车1927年5月26日停产，19年累计略超1500万辆。

sources.quote: The process netted 170,211 examples in 1913, 202,667 in 1914, well over half a million in 1916, and 735,020 in 1917. ... Output peaked at 2,011,125 in 1923 ... the T finally went out of production on May 26, 1927. Although final tallies vary, the generally accepted total stands at just over 15 million built.

fact: 1913年福特高地公园工厂的用工以移民为主，厂内设有英语学校与技工学校；1914年起「五美元日薪」附有品行条件，由公司社会部约50名调查员核查酗酒、赌博与家庭状况，未达标者只能拿基本工资。这套私人化的品行审查在1913年尚未实施。
